definition: Information retrieval (IR) in computing and information science is the task of identifying and retrieving information system resources that are relevant to an information need.
details: The information need can be specified in the form of a search query. In the case of document retrieval, queries can be based on full-text or other content-based indexing. Information retrieval is the science of searching for information in a document, searching for documents themselves, and also searching for the metadata that describes data, and for databases of texts, images, or sounds. Cross-modal retrieval implies retrieval across modalities. Automated information retrieval systems are used to reduce what has been called information overload. An IR system is a software system that provides access to books, journals, and other documents, as well as storing and managing those documents. Web search engines are the most visible IR applications.

explainer.lead: Information retrieval is the task of identifying and returning information system resources that are relevant to an information need. It matters because it underlies how people and systems find documents, metadata and media at scale.

tiers.eli5: It is like telling a librarian what you are looking for and getting back the shelf items that actually answer it.
tiers.practitioner: Engineers specify needs as queries—full-text or content-based—and rank resources by relevance, including cross-modal retrieval across text, images and sounds. A pitfall is that relevance depends on the need, which queries only approximate.
tiers.paperLevel: The task of identifying and retrieving information system resources relevant to an information need, which can be specified as a search query; document retrieval queries can use full-text or other content-based indexing. It covers searching within a document, for documents themselves, and for metadata describing data and databases of texts, images or sounds; cross-modal retrieval spans modalities.

explainer.example: A user submits a full-text query, and the system returns the documents whose indexed content is judged relevant to that need.
